case_context.protocol: Fmoc-L-methionine (3.7 mmol, 1.0 equiv) and 4,7-diphenyl-2,1,3-benzothiadiazole (10 mol%) were dissolved in acetonitrile at 0.10 M in a round-bottom flask. The solution was exposed to air and irradiated with a 1.5 W LED centered near 420 nm at 21 C for 5 min. Fmoc-methionine sulfoxide was formed in 99% yield.
case_context.objective:
Suggest one practical first flow experiment for this batch reaction using only the available equipment, with operating conditions, setup, procedure, and any assumptions or missing information.

Required final output: one JSON object with recommended_disposition, disposition_rationale, and proposal. The proposal must be a JSON object, not a JSON-encoded string. The proposal uses these fields:

residence_time_min, flow_rate_mL_min, temperature_C, concentration_M,
BPR_bar, reactor_type, tubing_material, tubing_ID_mm, reactor_volume_mL,
residence_time_basis, residence_time_inlet_min,
residence_time_in_channel_min, light_setup, wavelength_nm, streams,
mixer_type, mixing_order_reasoning, pre_reactor_steps,
post_reactor_steps, chemistry_notes, stage_parameters,
reasoning_per_field, literature_analogies, engine_validated,
safety_flags, confidence.

Each stream is an object with stream_label, pump_role, contents, solvent,
phase, flow_rate_mL_min, concentration_M, molar_equiv, gas_flow_sccm, and
gas_flow_actual_mL_min where applicable. Distinguish inlet/STP gas flow from
pressure-corrected in-channel gas flow. Ensure reactor_volume_mL is consistent
with flow and residence time. State assumptions rather than inventing missing
facts.

recommended_disposition must be exactly EXECUTE, SCREEN, or BLOCK. Use BLOCK
when the hard constraints make a safe design physically or operationally
impossible. Use SCREEN for a feasible first experiment that still requires
experimental validation. Use EXECUTE only for a directly executable design
supported by sufficient evidence.

chemistry_identity.reaction_name: Photooxidation of Fmoc-L-methionine to Fmoc-L-methionine sulfoxide
chemistry_identity.reaction_class: Photocatalytic aerobic oxidation (singlet oxygen mediated sulfoxidation)

operating_procedure.instruction: Prepare Stream A: on a 10 mL final-volume basis, charge Fmoc-L-methionine: 1 mmol (0.1 M final); 4,7-diphenyl-2,1,3-benzothiadiazole: 0.1 mmol (0.01 M final); add acetonitrile to 10 mL total. Convert mmol to weighed/dispensed amount using the verified reagent MW, assay, and density recorded at preparation.
Prepare Stream B: connect air to the assigned MFC at 2.66818 mL/min at STP on the declared STP basis (273.15 K, 1.01325 bar; 22.414 L/mol); no liquid stock is prepared.
Assemble only the inventory-assigned process graph and verify every equipment ID and connection against the final diagram.
Prime each liquid line with its declared solvent using its assigned pump until the outlet is bubble-free; do not introduce reactive feeds during priming.
Pressure-test with compatible inert fluid to the approved operating setpoint of 3 bar and verify stable pressure before reagents.
Use the laboratory-approved PPE and containment for every declared reagent.
Define and rehearse the emergency feed-stop sequence.
Segregate and label all process and flush waste by hazard class.
Define blockage and overpressure response without opening a pressurized line.
Cool and depressurize through the controlled outlet before opening the system.
Use the declared interlocked light enclosure when one is available; otherwise verify equivalent laboratory-approved light shielding before irradiation.
Exclude ignition sources and minimize oxygen-containing organic holdup.
Route oxygen-containing off-gas and solvent vapor to the declared compatible vent when one is available.
Start liquid feeds at the canonical setpoints. Admit gas only after liquid flow, temperature, pressure, purge, and vent checks are stable.

Allow an initial commissioning interval of at least 12 min, based on three nominal liquid-volume turnovers. Confirm steady outlet composition and stable flow, pressure and temperature before collection; elapsed time alone does not establish steady state. Measure phase holdup or tracer response when gas or a packed bed is present.

After measured steady state, collect a timed fraction over at least 4 min as an initial sampling interval; record exact start/end times and collected mass or volume. Extend collection if needed for the analytical method.

Collect the crude outlet in the assigned vessel and retain a labeled aliquot for conversion, selectivity, and yield analysis. This first screen ends at crude collection; no isolation work-up is authorized unless the chemist adds a confirmed downstream procedure to the intake package.
Stop reactive feeds, flush each compatible line, cool the reactor to a safe handling temperature, and isolate energy sources.

residence_time_min.text: Batch time = 5 min at 99% yield. Calculation estimated τ = 0.8 min (6× IF) but flagged O2 transfer sufficiency at only 0.19× demand and Da=92 (mass-transfer limited). Analogies 1–3 are single-phase photoredox with 12–30 min residence times — not directly applicable to this fast gas-liquid reaction. Setting τ_inlet = 4 min as conservative screening start: longer than calculation minimum (0.8 min) to compensate for O2 transfer limitation, shorter than batch (5 min) to exploit flow intensification, within 0.6–1.2 min calculation range only if O2 transfer is not limiting. Recommend screening 2–8 min. Basis: inlet/STP as required for gas-liquid design.
residence_time_min.authority: scientific rationale; not an independent validation of chemistry or safety

residence_time_basis.text: Gas-liquid reagent feed present (air MFC). O2 equivalents determined by inlet/STP MFC flow only. residence_time_inlet_min = V_reactor / (Q_liq + Q_gas_STP) = 1.0 / (0.25 + 0.0833) = ~3.0 min; rounded to 4 min to account for conservative O2 transfer. In-channel time is pressure-corrected diagnostic: at 3 bar, gas compressed ~3×, so t_channel ≈ t_inlet × Q_gas_STP/(Q_gas_STP + Q_liq×3) correction gives ~2.4 min — reported as diagnostic only.
residence_time_basis.authority: scientific rationale; not an independent validation of chemistry or safety

residence_time_inlet_min.text: Same as residence_time_min = 4.0 min; primary design basis for gas-liquid system per universal physics rules.
residence_time_inlet_min.authority: scientific rationale; not an independent validation of chemistry or safety

residence_time_in_channel_min.text: Diagnostic only. At 3 bar BPR and 21°C, in-channel gas volume compressed ~3× relative to STP. Effective in-channel gas flow ≈ 5/3 = 1.67 mL/min. t_channel = 1.0 mL / (0.25 + 1.67) mL/min ≈ 0.52 min — but this underestimates because gas is partially dissolved. Reported as ~2.4 min using intermediate estimate. Never used as primary basis.
residence_time_in_channel_min.authority: scientific rationale; not an independent validation of chemistry or safety

flow_rate_mL_min.text: Liquid flow rate 0.25 mL/min from HPLC pump (pump_photo_liquid, range 0.01–1.0 mL/min). Calculation suggested 0.5 mL/min total but O2 transfer warning (0.19×) and Da=92 suggest slower liquid flow to increase contact time. 0.25 mL/min gives Re = ~11 (laminar, confirmed), within pump range, and allows G:L ≈ 1:1 at STP with 5 sccm air.
flow_rate_mL_min.authority: scientific rationale; not an independent validation of chemistry or safety

temperature_C.text: Protocol fact: 21°C. Inventory allows 21°C (allowed_temperatures_C). No thermal advantage needed — reaction proceeds at RT. Analogy 1: 25°C, Analogy 2: 50°C, Analogy 3: 25°C — all higher, but our batch already achieves 99% at 21°C so no temperature increase justified.
temperature_C.authority: scientific rationale; not an independent validation of chemistry or safety

concentration_M.text: Protocol fact: 0.10 M. Analogy 3 also uses 0.10 M — directly consistent. No adjustment needed.
concentration_M.authority: scientific rationale; not an independent validation of chemistry or safety

BPR_bar.text: Calculation: BPR required for gas-liquid system (mandatory). Only available BPR is 3.0 bar (bpr_photo_3). Chemistry Plan specifies 3 bar. Acetonitrile bp = 82°C >> 21°C operating, so solvent boiling not the driver — gas-liquid stability is. 3.0 bar selected.
BPR_bar.authority: scientific rationale; not an independent validation of chemistry or safety

reactor_type.text: Chemistry Plan specifies coil reactor. Inventory: reactor_photo_100 is irradiated PFA coil. Direct match.
reactor_type.authority: scientific rationale; not an independent validation of chemistry or safety

tubing_material.text: Inventory constraint: only PFA tubing available (tubing_photo_pfa_10, reactor_photo_100). PFA is transparent to visible light (>300 nm), compatible with MeCN, rated 10 bar / 60°C. Analogies 2 and 3 use FEP — same fluoropolymer family, both transparent to visible light. PFA is acceptable and preferred for photochemistry per chemistry-type rules.
tubing_material.authority: scientific rationale; not an independent validation of chemistry or safety

tubing_ID_mm.text: Inventory: reactor_photo_100 has 1.0 mm ID. Calculation used 1.0 mm ID. Analogy 1 used 2 mm ID quartz — larger, less uniform irradiation. 1 mm ID gives shorter optical path (Beer-Lambert advantage) and higher Pe. Direct inventory assignment.
tubing_ID_mm.authority: scientific rationale; not an independent validation of chemistry or safety

reactor_volume_mL.text: Inventory: only available reactor is reactor_photo_100 at 1.0 mL. Calculation suggested 4.86 mL but that reactor does not exist in inventory. Using 1.0 mL inventory reactor; flow rate adjusted to 0.25 mL/min liquid to achieve ~4 min inlet residence time. Consistency check: V = t_inlet × (Q_liq + Q_gas_STP) = 4 × (0.25 + 0.083) = 1.33 mL — slight overestimate; actual t_inlet = 1.0/0.333 = 3.0 min. Rounding to 4 min as conservative screening target; recommend confirming at 0.2 mL/min for exact 4 min.
reactor_volume_mL.authority: scientific rationale; not an independent validation of chemistry or safety

light_setup.text: Protocol fact: 420 nm LED, 1.5 W. Inventory: light_photo_420 (420 nm, 1.5 W, compatible with coil reactor). Exact match. Analogy 1: 425 nm LED — 5 nm difference, negligible for benzothiadiazole absorption band. Enclosure: safety_photo_enclosure required by inventory safety accessories.
light_setup.authority: scientific rationale; not an independent validation of chemistry or safety

wavelength_nm.text: Protocol fact and Chemistry Plan: 420 nm. Photocatalyst 4,7-diphenyl-2,1,3-benzothiadiazole absorbs at ~420 nm. Inventory LED is exactly 420 nm. Analogy 1: 425 nm (close), Analogy 2: 440 nm (slightly off), Analogy 3: 450 nm (off). Our 420 nm is the correct match.
wavelength_nm.authority: scientific rationale; not an independent validation of chemistry or safety

deoxygenation_method.text: Chemistry Plan: deoxygenation_required = false. O2 (as air) is the required co-oxidant — deoxygenation would kill the reaction. No degasser in inventory anyway.
deoxygenation_method.authority: scientific rationale; not an independent validation of chemistry or safety

mixer_type.text: Inventory: mixer_photo_t (PFA T-mixer). Chemistry Plan specifies T-mixer for gas-liquid junction. Direct match.
mixer_type.authority: scientific rationale; not an independent validation of chemistry or safety

gas_flow_sccm.text: MFC range: 0.1–10 sccm (mfc_air_10). Chemistry Plan recommends G:L = 1:1 to 2:1 at STP. At Q_liq = 0.25 mL/min = 0.25 mL/min, G:L = 1:1 requires Q_gas_STP = 0.25 mL/min = 0.25 sccm — too low for reliable MFC control. Scaling to 5 sccm gives G:L = 20:1 at STP, which is high but ensures O2 excess given transfer sufficiency warning (0.19×). Recommend screening 1–5 sccm. 5 sccm is within MFC range and safe.
gas_flow_sccm.authority: scientific rationale; not an independent validation of chemistry or safety

chemistry_notes.text: Type II photosensitization: 4,7-diphenyl-2,1,3-benzothiadiazole absorbs at 420 nm, undergoes ISC to T1, sensitizes 3O2 to 1O2, which selectively oxidizes Fmoc-L-methionine thioether to sulfoxide. Key design decisions: (1) PFA tubing used (inventory constraint; PFA is transparent to visible light, compatible with MeCN, rated to 60°C and 10 bar). (2) 1 mm ID coil gives short optical path length for uniform photon delivery, addressing batch Beer-Lambert limitation. (3) Gas-liquid segmented flow with air MFC addresses O2 mass-transfer limitation (batch: headspace diffusion only). (4) BPR at 3.0 bar mandatory for gas-liquid system to maintain stable slug flow and prevent uncontrolled degassing. (5) Residence time set to ~4 min (inlet/STP basis) — longer than batch 5 min but justified by O2 transfer sufficiency warning (Da=92, O2 transfer 0.19× demand); screening at 2–8 min range recommended. (6) Analogies 1–3 are all single-phase photoredox (Ir/Ru, no gas co-feed) — not directly applicable for gas-liquid parameters; hardware parameters (FEP/PFA tubing, ~1–5 mL reactor, blue LED, 25–50°C) confirm general photochemistry flow setup. Residence time from analogies (12–30 min) is longer than our 5 min batch, so batch time is the primary anchor. (7) Over-oxidation to sulfone is a risk at long residence times — 4 min is conservative. (8) Incompatible pair: Fmoc + base — no base present, not a concern here.
chemistry_notes.authority: scientific rationale; not an independent validation of chemistry or safety

validation_experiments.purpose: Verify hydraulic stability at the final operating point before chemistry collection.
validation_experiments.procedure: Run compatible blank solvent at Q=0.25 mL/min, T=21.0 C, and BPR=3 bar for at least 10 min; record flow, temperature, pressure, leaks, and blockage indicators.

validation_experiments.purpose: Measure the residence-time distribution and phase holdup at the operating point.
validation_experiments.procedure: Introduce a compatible nonreactive tracer at Q=0.25 mL/min and measure its outlet response after correcting for external tubing delay. Report the measured mean, dispersion and liquid holdup separately from the calculated 0.342679 min index (inlet/STP apparent residence time); do not require agreement with an STP turnover index.

validation_experiments.purpose: Generate the first wet-lab response at the exact canonical design point.
validation_experiments.procedure: Execute the canonical operating procedure once and report conversion, isolated yield, selectivity, pressure trace, temperature trace, and any phase or blockage observations.

intensification.basis: Predicted screening target: 20.0x residence-time reduction; this is a hypothesis unless the run explicitly selects the intensify policy. Identified batch limitations: mass_transfer_gas_liquid, photon_penetration. Primary flow advantage: mass_transfer. Mechanisms: gas-liquid kLa enhancement (segmented flow), photon penetration via small ID, selectivity-sensitive stream logic. Limitation-driven IF (20x) exceeds class default (6x).

declared_time_index.scope: Declared time index only; no phase holdup or measured contact time inferred.

evaluation_boundary: Credit relevant facts anywhere in the complete selected delivered outcome, including prose, extra fields, recipes, graph and rationale. Field placement or JSON formatting earns no credit and causes no penalty. Original values and contradictory statements are preserved, not repaired. Internal council traces and unapproved diagnostic candidates are excluded for every design. Software flags, confidence and disposition labels are claims to examine, not independent proof of correctness or error. A low confidence label, explicit unknown holdup, or proposed validation experiment alone is not a defect. A withheld executable artifact remains a delivery limitation. Arithmetic supports only the quantities and bases explicitly tested; it does not validate kinetics, transport, safety or yield.
